summary: AIOS Tech Inc., a Hong Kong-domiciled foreign private issuer listed on a US exchange, filed a Form 6-K on September 30, 2026 disclosing that independent director Ms. Yishi Huang resigned effective that same day, citing other commitments and expressly stating no disagreement with the Company on operations, policies or practices. She also vacated her roles as nominating committee chairperson and as a member of the audit and compensation committees. The Board and nominating committee are actively searching for a qualified replacement. No transaction, terms, advisor, premium or structural mechanics are stated. This is a routine board-vacancy disclosure, not a forced CEO/CFO event; watch committee quorum and governance risk.
